fields.name: npc
fields.coerce: none: used as an object key
fields.description: The key of an NPC. The server keys NPCs in `instance.players` as `NPC_prefix` (`"NPC0000000000000000NPC"`, node/server_functions.js:40) plus the NPC id or name (node/server_functions.js:1263, 1949). The handler looks the id up in `players`, which holds only the characters of connected sockets, keyed by socket id (node/server.js:11890). Thus it never finds an NPC.

failures.intro: The handler has no game effect. Its last step only writes a server log line for Marven.

rows.when: `players[npc]` is not an NPC. This is always true: `players` holds no NPC.
You are more than 1,000 px from the NPC. The server cannot reach this check.

confirm.note: Unreachable: the check before always returns
